applyConstraints: Implement only the approved Applicable Check execution contract.
Preserve host-owned repositoryRoot and host-derived candidate identity.
Keep ignored material out of candidate bytes and .flowkit/runs/** excluded for self-invalidation.
Preserve exact Git-visible mode/kind candidate identity including 100644/100755/120000/tracked deletion.
Preserve environmentRefs in checkRef and closed ApplicableCheckExecutionInput/executionInputRef binding.
Reuse only explicit prior successful facts with exact current candidateRef + checkRef equality.
Do not add Registry/Planner/Evidence/cache/history/snapshot subsystems or new authority.
